YES

The script builds the keep index by iterating 8 blocks of 768 rows (qkv) or 256 columns (dense) and skipping block 5, which yields exactly rows `0..3839, 4608..6143` and columns `0..1279, 1536..2047` in order, applied on the correct axis for each of the 16 layers. All other tensors and names are untouched, dtype is preserved by `index_select`, the four required checks are asserted before `save_file`, and the output lands at `out/T2/model.safetensors`.
